description: PAID $0.01. Curated post-mortems with agent/sentiment/timing/model/risk + citations. Returns JSON curated post-mortems with agent, sentiment, timing, model, risk notes, and citations.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: Maximum rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 10. Omit for the server's current cap.

model.description: Optional model-name filter. Format: a model id string. Example: gpt-4. Omit for every model.

q.description: Optional text search. Format: plain words. Example: alpha arena. Omit to list the newest curated rows.

name: postmortems_search
title: Trading-agent post-mortem search ($0.01)
